moonstone.author: Michael Gunther
moonstone.alt: Near-overhead view of a carved granite moonstone, its concentric bands showing a procession of elephants, horses, lions and bulls, then a band of geese, scrollwork and rings of lotus petals

moonstone-polonnaruwa.author: Michael Gunther

makara.caption: Makara balustrade at the Vatadage, Polonnaruwa
